description: We are a team of four with diverse backgrounds and a shared passion for creating. Beyza specializes in test automation, Emre is an emergency physician passionate about coding, Oğuz Kağan is a sixth-grade content creator who discovered programming through Scratch, and Ayşe is a fourth-year Computer Engineering student with a keen interest in design. Ready, Martian? is our first project together, born at the NASA Space Apps Challenge. This is just the beginning!
